name: app_service
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk app service (Kubernetes Deployment).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this app service.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the app service resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this app service to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this app service belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the deployment is created in.

attributes.name: deployment_name
attributes.description: Name of the Kubernetes Deployment object (typically the same as name).

attributes.name: replicas
attributes.description: Number of pod replicas.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Deployment update strategy: RollingUpdate or Recreate.

attributes.name: service_account_name
attributes.description: Service account the pods run as.

attributes.name: image_pull_secrets
name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret (type kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson) in the same namespace used to pull images from a private registry.
Image pull secrets referenced by the pods, for pulling container images from private registries.

attributes.name: match_labels
attributes.description: Deployment selector matchLabels. Must match pod_labels.

attributes.name: pod_labels
attributes.description: Labels applied to the pod template (must satisfy match_labels).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the Deployment object.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the Deployment object.

attributes.name: containers
attributes.description: Containers that make up the pod.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Container name.

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: Container image (e.g. nginx:1.27).

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Entrypoint override.

attributes.name: args
attributes.description: Arguments to the entrypoint.

attributes.name: image_pull_policy
attributes.description: Image pull policy: Always, IfNotPresent, or Never.

attributes.name: working_dir
attributes.description: Container working directory.

attributes.name: ports
attributes.description: Ports the container exposes.

attributes.name: container_port
attributes.description: Port number the container listens on.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Named port.

attributes.name: protocol
attributes.description: Protocol: TCP, UDP, or SCTP.

attributes.name: env
attributes.description: Environment variables (literal values).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Variable name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Variable value.

attributes.name: resources_limits
attributes.description: Resource limits, e.g. { cpu = "500m", memory = "512Mi" }.

attributes.name: resources_requests
attributes.description: Resource requests, e.g. { cpu = "250m", memory = "256Mi" }.

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: Optional Kubernetes Service exposing the deployment. Omit to create no Service.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Service apiVersion.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Service kind.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Service object.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Service type. LoadBalancer provisions an external endpoint.

attributes.name: ports
attributes.description: Service ports.

attributes.name: port
attributes.description: Port the Service exposes.

attributes.name: target_port
attributes.description: Container port traffic is forwarded to.

attributes.name: protocol
attributes.description: Protocol.

attributes.name: node_port
attributes.description: Static node port (NodePort/LoadBalancer).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Named port.

attributes.name: ingress
attributes.description: Optional Kubernetes Ingress exposing the Service over HTTP(S). Omit to create no Ingress.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Ingress apiVersion.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Ingress kind.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Ingress object.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Ingress annotations (e.g. controller-specific config).

attributes.name: ingress_class_name
attributes.description: IngressClass name (e.g. nginx, alb).

attributes.name: rules
attributes.description: Host/path routing rules.

attributes.name: host
attributes.description: Host this rule matches.

attributes.name: paths
attributes.description: HTTP paths routed to a backend Service.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: URL path.

attributes.name: path_type
attributes.description: Path match type.

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: Backend Service name.

attributes.name: service_port_number
attributes.description: Backend Service port number.

attributes.name: replication_type
attributes.description: How the deployment's replica count is managed: Static (fixed replicas), Hpa (managed by the hpa block), or ExternalHpa (managed by an HPA outside this resource). Must be set to Hpa when an hpa block is configured.

attributes.name: hpa
attributes.description: Optional HorizontalPodAutoscaler that scales the deployment between min and max replicas based on metrics. Requires replication_type = "Hpa". The platform sets the autoscaler's name and scale target to this app service's workload automatically. Omit to create no autoscaler.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler apiVersion.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler kind.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Annotations applied to the HorizontalPodAutoscaler object.

attributes.name: min_replicas
attributes.description: Lower bound on the number of replicas the autoscaler can scale down to. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

attributes.name: max_replicas
attributes.description: Upper bound on the number of replicas the autoscaler can scale up to. Must be greater than or equal to min_replicas.

attributes.name: metrics
attributes.description: Metrics the autoscaler evaluates to compute the desired replica count. Each entry sets one metric source via the block matching its type.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Metric source type. Set the block matching this value: resource, pods, external, or container_resource.

attributes.name: resource
attributes.description: Resource metric (e.g. cpu or memory) of the target pods. Use with type Resource.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Resource name, e.g. cpu or memory.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Target the metric is scaled against.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Target type: Utilization, Value, or AverageValue.

attributes.name: average_utilization
attributes.description: Target average resource utilization across pods, as a percentage (use with type Utilization).

attributes.name: average_value
attributes.description: Target average value of the metric across pods, as a quantity, e.g. "500Mi" (use with type AverageValue).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Target raw value of the metric, as a quantity (use with type Value).

attributes.name: container_resource
attributes.description: Resource metric of a single named container in each pod. Use with type ContainerResource.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Resource name, e.g. cpu or memory.

attributes.name: container
attributes.description: Name of the container in the pod to measure.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Target the metric is scaled against.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Target type: Utilization, Value, or AverageValue.

attributes.name: average_utilization
attributes.description: Target average resource utilization across pods, as a percentage (use with type Utilization).

attributes.name: average_value
attributes.description: Target average value of the metric across pods, as a quantity (use with type AverageValue).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Target raw value of the metric, as a quantity (use with type Value).

attributes.name: pods
attributes.description: Custom per-pod metric averaged across all target pods. Use with type Pods.

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: Name of the custom pods metric.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Target the metric is scaled against.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Target type: Utilization, Value, or AverageValue.

attributes.name: average_utilization
attributes.description: Target average utilization across pods, as a percentage (use with type Utilization).

attributes.name: average_value
attributes.description: Target average value of the metric across pods, as a quantity (use with type AverageValue).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Target raw value of the metric, as a quantity (use with type Value).

attributes.name: external
attributes.description: Metric from a source not associated with any Kubernetes object. Use with type External.

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: Name of the external metric.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Target the metric is scaled against.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Target type: Utilization, Value, or AverageValue.

attributes.name: average_utilization
attributes.description: Target average utilization, as a percentage (use with type Utilization).

attributes.name: average_value
attributes.description: Target average value of the metric, as a quantity (use with type AverageValue).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Target raw value of the metric, as a quantity (use with type Value).

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: Name of the provisioned Service (if any).

attributes.name: ingress_name
attributes.description: Name of the provisioned Ingress (if any).

attributes.name: hpa_name
attributes.description: Name of the provisioned HorizontalPodAutoscaler (set when replication_type is Hpa).
